_comment: Reference scatter presets for zone-based pattern emission (ADR 0054 follow-up). Per-zone-NAME defaults for density / spacing / scale jitter. compile_map applies these by zone name; per-game asset_resolution.json can override OR pick a preset by name.

forest_dense._comment: Tight tree cover, ~3m spacing. Survival game camp perimeters, dark woods.

forest_sparse._comment: Open woodland, ~6m spacing. Walkable forest between landmarks.

forest_very_dense._comment: Impenetrable thicket. Use only for narrative boundary forests, not walkable.

grass_tuft._comment: Decorative ground grass — sparse small tufts. Use on grass-zone for flavor.

rocks_field._comment: Open rock field — quarry, mountain face.

decorative_props._comment: Generic decorative scatter — flowers, mushrooms, debris. Low density.
